Agentic GenAI Engineer (Anthropic)
8-9 years Noida/Remote

Experience: 8-9 years
Primary Stack: Python, GCP, Google ADK, Anthropic, LangChain

Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Agentic GenAI Engineer to join AI Center of Excellence (AICOE) and drive the
design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered agentic systems. This role focuses on
building intelligent automation solutions leveraging Anthropic models, Google ADK, and modern GenAI
frameworks on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The ideal candidate will play a key role in translating business
requirements into scalable AI solutions, developing multi-agent workflows, and optimizing LLM-based
applications for enterprise use cases.

Required Technical Skills
Programming Languages
o Strong proficiency in Python for AI/ML and backend development
Cloud Technologies
o Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as:
Vertex AI
Cloud Functions / Cloud Run
BigQuery / Cloud Storage
IAM security best practices
GenAI / Agentic Frameworks
o Experience working with Anthropic (Claude models) APIs
o Practical experience in building agentic workflows using Google ADK
o Strong understanding of LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and multi-agent
architecture
o Working knowledge of LangChain for building LLM-powered pipelines and applications
Databases / Vector Stores
o Hands-on experience with at least one:
Vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma)
Traditional databases (SQL/NoSQL)
o Experience implementing RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipelines
Core AI/ML Skills
o LLM fine-tuning / prompt optimization strategies
o Evaluation and monitoring of GenAI applications
o API integration and microservices architecture

Required Experience
8-9 years of overall experience in software engineering, AI/ML, or related domains
At least 3+ years of hands-on experience in GenAI / LLM-based application development
Proven experience building and deploying production-grade AI systems on GCP
Demonstrated expertise in designing agentic workflows and autonomous AI systems
Strong problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and solution design capabilities
